description: Links as the tracker packed them with link 3 (the timeline in bits, the settings as JSON), recorded by the packLink of v2.59.0 (commit ac42aff9), the first release to write it, each beside the save it was made from, every one with finds (a save without one is written as link 2). They stand for links already shared: never change their content or regenerate them (Biome only orders their keys).
